summary: Create a live insertion-ordered Set value iterator.

semantics.live: new values added before completion may be visited

tests.name: delete readd appends
tests.input: const s=new Set([1,2]); const it=s.values(); console.log(it.next().value); s.delete(2); s.add(2); console.log(it.next().value);
tests.expected_behavior: prints 1 then 2 from the re-added position
